title: pos.transactions.v1 message value
description: Payment submitted by a terminal. Key: terminal_id. Header event_type: transaction.submitted.

schema_version.description: Schema version. An unknown version sends the message to the DLQ.

transaction_id.description: UUIDv7 generated by the terminal at confirmation time. Stays the same on retries from the local queue.

terminal_id.description: Terminal identifier. Also used as the Kafka message key.

amount_minor.description: Amount in the minor unit of the currency (kopecks for RUB), greater than 0.

created_at.description: Terminal time in UTC, RFC 3339 with milliseconds.

seq.description: Per-terminal event counter, gaps reveal lost events.
